thread:
Priya Patel: quick sync — vendor just flagged a slip on MI300 GA and a firmware candidate for Gaudi that might affect our perf numbers. we need to re-run the compatibility matrix before we lock marketplace announce windows.

Marco Rivera: saw that. vendor sent firmware v2.1.3 this morning — initial runs show tail-latency increase at 8k seq on B200. i opened an issue with hw-team.

Linh Tran: lab capacity note — we have 4 racks available week of 10/11, but Rack-3 is reserved for quantization runs until 10/13. can pivot if needed.

Sanjay Rao: proposal: staggered onramp — SI dryrun week of 10/18, limited marketplace listing 11/01, public press window 11/15. keeps us room for QA and embargo.

vendor-bot: vendor update: H200 allocation increased; H100 availability unchanged. potential embargo window requested: 11/10-11/17.

Priya Patel: thanks. action items: 1) linh — run full compat matrix (B200/H200/H100, MI300, Gaudi) and surface any kernel/driver blockers by EOD Friday; 2) marco — triage firmware perf regression with hw-team and ask for regression trace; 3) sanjay — draft the staggered launch timeline and comms playbook for SI/partners.

Linh Tran: copying checklist — will run matrix and upload CSV + short notes. link will be in #partnerships when done (https://redwood.internal/s/compat-matrix)

Marco Rivera: quick debug snippet i ran:
```
# reproduce tail-latency locally
kubectl apply -f perf/test-deploy.yaml
./run_perf --model llama-2-13b --seq-len 8192 --batch 1 --iters 200
```
Stack trace shows KV cache growth spike after step ~120. passing to hw-team.

Sanjay Rao: also a heads-up for Console team — we should prepare a rollback + fallback routing policy: route H100 -> H200 variant or to lighter quantized model if HW capacity is constrained. can we get a draft policy?

Priya Patel: yes — ops, put a 5% canary rule in for the first week of listing, then ramp. include automatic fallback to quantized variant and circuit-breaker at 3xx/5xx error spike.

Marco Rivera: noted. i'll add an item to the runtime backlog to make sure kernel ABI change is tested across our distro images. small patch looked like: `drivers/gpu: fix page-alignment in dma map` — could affect older AMIs.

Linh Tran: if vendor can push an alternate firmware build, we can re-run the 8k seq tests in the Rack-2 *tomorrow* and get numbers by EOD. i'm scheduling runs at 09:00 PT.

vendor-bot: vendor action: provisioning extra GA samples to Rack-2 confirmed. ETA: 24 hours.

Priya Patel: perfect. last item — legal needs embargo window + partner mention list by Friday. @Sanjay, please draft and loop in legal.

Sanjay Rao: will do, drafting now. ping me if you want partner priority order.

Priya Patel: thanks all. quick emoji check: :thumbsup: if you can hit your items by Fri.

Marco Rivera: :thumbsup:

Linh Tran: :thumbsup:

Sanjay Rao: :thumbsup:
